preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
Each test case must have a sequence length n between 2 and 300,000.
The total sum of n across all test cases must not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == n and all(1 <= a <= 10**9 for a in output)
postconditions.description: The output must contain n distinct integers, each between 1 and 10^9.
The difference between the maximum and minimum of the output must equal the square root of the sum of the output.
All integers in the output must be distinct.
